topic: CIEL Server Hub audit and rebuild plan

runtime.observed_issue: endpoint timeouts possible when request path blocks; direct component reads are fast

critical_findings: Frontend calls endpoints not implemented by backend: /api/modules, /api/modules/:name/:action, /api/metrics, /api/stream, /api/bloch, /api/projects.
Memory Hub is not present in current static SPA: no #memory nav, no site/js/pages/memory.js.
Existing memory assets are fragmented across build_memory_portal.py, old Jinja templates, raw DB and TSM importer.
noema_portal_daemon.py mixes static serving, system reads, DB reads, settings writes and route logic in one handler.
Current portal is a status panel with glued pages, not a server hub for CIEL.
pass_criteria: Memory page shows real raw/TSM data.
Endpoints do not block the whole server.
